scope: Real Rust Front/Backend and bounded Unix IPC, optional helper and OpenSSH, generated encrypted keys with isolated loopback sshd. A simulated frontend thread supplies fixture answers; this is not GUI/password/2FA/Windows or fair performance validation. Positive cases list and verify 1MiB bidirectional data after VERSION; authentication stage is already closed. Waiting case delays answer 1.5s with a 1s network timeout. No user SSH files/agent/credentials. Samples include the Rust test harness and simulated frontend, not production idle costs.
